prompt: A brick road tunnel lined with faded teal mosaics, a 35mm lens looking along a diagonal. Two parked 1920s black sedans sit behind the camera, one mudguard and big round headlamp just visible at the right edge, their yellow beams lighting a row of people. Nearest us, the singer, front-on, face a third of the frame high, mouth open and well lit. Receding behind him, smaller each time, a Black upright bass player of about 60, tall and white-haired; a slim woman drummer of about 35 with bobbed black hair; a tubby young Italian American trumpeter of about 25; a wiry fingerpicking guitarist of about 70, bald. At the far tunnel mouth two silhouettes hold Thompsons pointing at the roof. No lettering, no black bars. Thanks.
